items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Boston for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very happy to have Fred Lipsius with me today.

ctx.x: Fred was interviewed in Boston, Massachusetts on July 25, 2018 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Boston for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very happy to have Fred Lipsius with me today. And I’ve been looking forward actually to talking to you since 1969.
